description: Poly CLOB: Raw Polymarket CLOB order book for one outcome token — every resting bid and ask exactly as the exchange returns it. Needs a token id from x402-poly-markets or x402-polymarket. For derived views use x402-poly-depth (cumulative), x402-poly-walls (large clusters) or x402-poly-signals (just the touch).
name: x402-poly-clob
